text.t01: [breathless] Sorry to keep you waiting…! [giggles] I had no idea a furisode was this hard to run in.
text.t02: [shy] Um… how do I look? Does it suit me?
text.t03a: [surprised] B-beautiful…!? [shy] …Thank you. My face feels hot…
text.t03b: [giggles] Hehe, I'm fine. [warmly] This stole was my grandmother's — it's very warm.
text.t04: [excited] Oh, five seconds left! Shall we count down together?
text.t05: [warmly] Happy New Year. This year… [shy] let's get even closer, all right?
text.t07: [embarrassed] Um… I don't carry cash. [curious] …Do you think they take cards?
text.t08a: [surprised] Oh my…! [warmly] Then I'll repay you next year, I promise.
text.t08b: [curious] Excuse me, do you take cards… oh, no? [giggles] …Hehe, could you treat me after all?
text.t09: [playful] Here, this one's yours. …Your cheek must be cold, right? There!
text.t10: [softly] …Fuu, fuu. [surprised] Hot…! [giggles] Hehe, I can't handle hot drinks.
text.t11: [softly] The bonfire is so warm… Hold your hands out — your fingertips tingle.
text.t12: [surprised] Eek…! [whispers] I-I'm sorry. It's so crowded… …Could we stay like this, just a little longer?
text.t15a: [pouting] That's not fair. [giggles] …Then mine's a secret too.
text.t15b: [surprised] …! [shy] …Same. That's exactly what I wished for.
text.t16: [sad] …Bad luck. The first bad-luck fortune of my life…
text.t17a: [surprised] Huh, swap… are you sure? [warmly] …Hehe, I'll treasure your great-luck fortune.
text.t17b: [excited] Yes…! If we tie it together, it's sure to turn lucky.
text.t18: [softly] The wind is so cold… You're freezing, aren't you? [warmly] …Here, we'll share.
text.t19a: [whispers] …I'll tell you a little of my secret. I wished I could be beside you again next year.
text.t19b: [whispers] Next year, and the year after that… I want to come here with you.
